turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's my gran's ninetieth and I want to show a film at the party. I've got a few ideas.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Please wait until I've gone through all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's an old musical she says she saw at the cinema with my grandad back when they were courting.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a nature documentary about the seaside town she grew up in, very gentle and pretty.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another idea is a black and white comedy that she still quotes at Christmas every year.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The musical has the most meaning, it's tied to a memory of your grandad, which could be really moving. The comedy is a guaranteed laugh since she already loves it. The documentary is lovely but maybe better as background than the main event.
